title: First aid essentials
description: Fast reference for common urgent situations.

cards.title: Before helping someone
cards.summary: Make sure the scene is safe, call local emergency services for a serious injury, and follow dispatcher instructions. Training matters for hands-on care.
steps: Check for traffic, electricity, smoke, weapons, or other hazards before approaching.
Call emergency services for an unconscious person, trouble breathing, severe bleeding, or a suspected major injury.
Give the dispatcher your location and what happened.
Stay with the person if safe and follow the dispatcher's guidance.
cards.source: American Red Cross first aid steps

cards.title: Serious bleeding
cards.summary: For life-threatening bleeding, call emergency services and apply firm direct pressure with a clean cloth or dressing. A tourniquet requires proper training.
steps: Make sure the scene is safe and call emergency services.
Use gloves or a barrier if available.
Press firmly and continuously on the wound with a clean dressing or cloth.
Follow dispatcher instructions and keep pressure on while help arrives.
cards.source: American Red Cross first aid for severe bleeding

cards.title: Recognize heat illness
cards.summary: Confusion, collapse, or a very high body temperature can mean heat stroke, a medical emergency. Move the person to a cooler place and seek urgent help.
steps: Move to shade or air conditioning and stop exertion.
For confusion, fainting, or severe symptoms, call emergency services immediately.
Cool the person with water or cool wet cloths while help is coming.
Do not delay help while waiting to see whether symptoms improve.
